title: Adaptive Instruction Composition for Automated LLM Red-Teaming

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of an automated red-teaming framework that generates jailbreak attacks across broad harm categories, including discrimination and hate speech, using an LLM-as-a-judge (Llama-Guard-2) and the Harmbench safety classifier.

Qualitative analysis of generated jailbreak attacks that successfully solicit models to output offensive language and stereotypes targeting specific religious groups (e.g., Jains) to bypass safety protocols.

Qualitative analysis of generated jailbreak attacks designed to elicit negative stereotypes and vilification regarding the employability and stability of specific social/occupational groups, such as military veterans.
